timing.interpretation: Inclusive wall/process CPU may nest and overlap, including concurrent Promise.all reads. Never sum these as exclusive cost. SelectNext core is not independently instrumented unless explicitly recorded. Native host/Docker VM CPU is not process CPU.
timing.function_substitution_scope: Wrappers call captured original exactly once with same this/arguments and preserve result/throw; async wrappers add measured scheduling overhead. No alternate selector, candidate or grant.
